title: Collections and Credit Reporting Standard for the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan
content:
### Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan: delinquency, charge-off, credit reporting and payoff figures

The figures in this standard are the same in all six tiers of the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan, Paystride Payroll Loan 500 through Paystride Payroll Loan 5000.

| Standard | Figure in every tier |
|---|---|
| Days past due at which an unpaid loan is charged off | 120 days |
| Payment history reported to the consumer credit bureaus | Yes |
| Days past due before a late payment is reported | 30 days |
| Calendar days a payoff quote stays valid | 10 calendar days |
| Business days to refund a final overpayment | 5 business days |

### Days past due

Days past due are the calendar days since the earliest scheduled installment that is not fully paid.

### Thresholds on both sides (hypothetical loans)

| Hypothetical days past due | Late payment reportable at the 30-day figure | Charge-off figure of 120 days reached |
|---|---|---|
| 29 | No | No |
| 30 | Yes | No |
| 119 | Yes | No |
| 120 | Yes | Yes |

### Payoff quote and final overpayment

A payoff quote stays valid for 10 calendar days: a hypothetical quote issued 4 calendar days ago is still valid, and one issued 15 calendar days ago is not. A final overpayment is refunded within 5 business days.
